title: Hill Insurance
pitch: Ambrose Kell pays Victor to keep his hill quiet. Two months now he hasn't. He says he doesn't pay boys.

clue_a.label: The fountain
lines: New bronze lions on the fountain, the sculptor's chalk still on the plinths. Weeks old, not years. Kell isn't short.

clue_b.label: The car by the steps
lines: A new saloon, dealer's tag still on the mirror, bill of sale on the seat. Paid in full, last week.
